requirement_compliance.title: Jitter-tolerant sustained-breach confirmation by elapsed span
requirement_compliance.evidence: Covered by TC-SAW-016h (jitter), TC-SAW-016e (knife-edge missing-sample), TC-SAW-016b (boundary: span exactly D + single-sample), TC-SAW-016f (negative: span < D). Aitri verify-run: 4 passing, 0 failing, 0 skipped for FR-016.

requirement_compliance.title: Bounded sample retention for the sustained window
requirement_compliance.evidence: Covered by TC-SAW-017h (0 allocations per add over 1000 calls), TC-SAW-017e (len(samples) <= 2 after a 100x-duration breach), TC-SAW-017f (run-start preserved across 10000 samples). Aitri verify-run: 3 passing, 0 failing for FR-017.

requirement_compliance.title: Non-breaching sample resets the window (regression)
requirement_compliance.evidence: Covered by TC-SAW-005h (clean restart after reset), TC-SAW-005e (non-breach on empty window is a safe no-op), TC-SAW-005f (active run cleared; no confirmation from stale samples). 3 passing.

requirement_compliance.title: Gap > 2*interval resets the window (regression)
requirement_compliance.evidence: Covered by TC-SAW-006h (gap == 2*interval keeps run), TC-SAW-006e (gap just over 2*interval resets), TC-SAW-006f (post-gap fresh run; no stale confirmation). 3 passing.

requirement_compliance.title: duration <= 0 short-circuits to the breaching flag (regression)
requirement_compliance.evidence: Covered by TC-SAW-007h (duration 0, true), TC-SAW-007e (negative duration mirrors flag), TC-SAW-007f (duration 0, false). 3 passing.

requirement_compliance.title: Interval-aligned confirmation preserved (regression, TC-NA-076e)
requirement_compliance.evidence: Covered by TC-SAW-008h (aligned confirms at exactly D), TC-SAW-008e (stable past D), TC-SAW-008f (aligned but span < D does not confirm). The pre-existing TC-NA-076e and TC-NA-076f also still pass after the change. 3 passing.

requirement_compliance.title: No change to cooldown / dedup / dispatch (regression)
requirement_compliance.evidence: Covered by TC-SAW-009h (one fire on confirmation), TC-SAW-009e (re-fire after cooldown elapses), TC-SAW-009f (no duplicate inside cooldown), via evaluateMetricRule + db.ListAlerts. Existing engine cooldown/fire-resolve tests also pass unchanged. 3 passing.

requirement_compliance.title: CI runs the suite on push to main (CI/CD)
requirement_compliance.evidence: Existing .github/workflows/security-gate.yml triggers on push to main and pull_request, runs `go test ./...` (including the new alerts tests) and govulncheck. Asserted by TC-SAW-010h (trigger + test command), TC-SAW-010e (whole-module ./...), TC-SAW-010f (failures not masked). 3 passing. No new workflow added.

requirement_compliance.title: Security not applicable beyond no-regression (SHOULD)
requirement_compliance.evidence: Verified by diff review: the change touches only internal/alerts/engine.go window logic and its test file — no new HTTP handler, input parser, exec call, query, or secret-handling path. No automated security test (no new attack surface to test); covered by static review per the FR-011 privilege-separation posture.

technical_debt_inherited.substitution: Implementation keeps a 2-entry bounded `samples` slice (run-start + latest) instead of the scalar firstAt/lastAt fields proposed in 02_SYSTEM_DESIGN.md ADR-002.
technical_debt_inherited.reason: The existing regression test TC-NA-076f inspects `w.samples` directly (require.Len(w.samples, 1)); removing the field would break its compilation, violating the regression boundary. The 2-entry cap still delivers O(1) memory (FR-017) and span-based confirmation (FR-016) — verified by TC-SAW-017e and TC-SAW-017h.
technical_debt_inherited.effort_to_fix: low — could migrate to scalar fields and update TC-NA-076f if the slice field is ever removed; no functional benefit, so deliberately not done.
